scope: Recipe Book opening delay and missing substitute availability

opening.cause: RecipeBookItemIcon and hover wrappers eagerly projected full item references for visible icons even while their previews were closed.
opening.fix: Resolve references only when the Tooltip overlay or pinned popover builds. Keep existing controller revision-aware caching, hover delays, keyboard actions and shared card layout.
opening.measurement: Synthetic Windows Flutter widget test, not a live release frame-time guarantee. Cooking first-frame work: baseline 761733 microseconds, corrected standalone run 131392 microseconds. Timing assertions are diagnostic; the regression enforces zero item projections on opening and one after clicking an item.

availability.cause: Imported High-quality labels did not match High-Quality recipe keys. The old fallback also rejected registry-only references and NPC availability suppressed market information.
availability.fix: Resolve exact normalized names using immutable per-recipe-map indexes and the bundled identity registry. Reject conflicting numeric identities; preserve market eligibility/exclusions. Show NPC and market badges together when both apply. Request through the existing shared broker; unknown and stale counts stay unknown.
availability.coverage: 3813 mode/name identity checks across 1271 eligible ingredient and grade labels; actual Wheat Flour and dual-source Paprika cards in three themes at 100% and 200% text.
availability.shared_surfaces: Recipe Book, Planner, Opportunities item-reference cards and previews, plus the Planner's shared substitute chooser.
availability.layout: Processing alternatives retain inline badges; quality columns retain badges underneath. No new grade conversion, ingredient, price preference or recipe calculation.

inherited_test_expectations: Two source-copy tests also failed on the preserved previous source. Updated only their exact expected grouping to the already-approved single-route bullets (seller, price and restriction stay together). No acquisition text or game facts changed in this delivery.
safety: Synthetic profiles and mock market only. Prior source/runnable and accepted rollback preserved, no user-state access. Local Beta-by-Codex side-by-side delivery only; no normal-app update or publication.
